text:
Which statement about oxides of nitrogen is correct?
A
They are made in car engines by the incomplete combustion of gasoline at a high
temperature.
B
They are made in car engines when nitrogen in gasoline reacts with oxygen in air at a high
temperature.
C
They are removed from car exhausts by catalytic converters and form nitrogen and
sulfur dioxide.
D
They are removed from car exhausts when they react with carbon monoxide in catalytic
converters.
